boundaries: Same-EOA funding signer acceptance and enable-trading remain unverified. No new wallet or private key.
Explicit read-only POST; opening pages and receiving WebSocket events do not automatically sign.
No documented history pagination, update watermark, retention or complete-history guarantee.
First baseline suppresses existing history; later previously unseen record/state combinations notify once. No transition order is invented.
Record time and observation time are different. No completion time, fabricated failure reason or inference from bc.
Preferences v2 stores inbox and baseline together, preserving v1 read states. Local best-effort persistence, not system push or guaranteed background delivery.
Tracking overflow refuses new observations without dropping baseline; notifications remain bounded and may be pruned.
Actual deposit/withdrawal/transfers, subaccounts, complete valuation, Chase/BBO/Scaled remain incomplete. BAPI history and TWAP remain skipped by user request.
